text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging eng-oncall — continuous-batcher (us-west-2) p99 spike. SLO=1s. Observed: p95=720ms p99=4.2s. streaming stalls increased, requests queued behind large packs. Alert window: last 10m.

alex: seeing it. multiple nodes in pool reporting KV cache churn and big pack sizes.

maya: confirmed in graphs — sequence-length distribution shifted, heavy tail from a few long-chat sessions. Mixed-seqlen packer ended up building very large batches.

jun: estimated customer impact? any external 5xxs?

sam: errors low, but streaming stalls (chunk delays) for some customers. Dashboard shows ~3% of streaming sessions had stall >2s, which clients interpret as timeouts.

taylor: AcmeHealth reported degraded UX via support ticket 4621, timestamp matches spike window.

alex: immediate mitigation ideas: 1) throttle max_pack_size for continuous-batcher 2) enable seqlen-bucketing (fast path) 3) temporarily reduce max_batch_duration to force smaller packs.

maya: agree. smallest blast radius: flip `max_pack_size=8` and `max_batch_duration_ms=40` on the affected cluster.

jun: how to toggle live? we have the runtime flag `pack: { max_pack_size: N, max_latency_ms: M }` exposed via configmap.

sam: I'd rather avoid full deploy. We can patch via runtime-config endpoint: `POST /admin/runtime-config` with the JSON. Example: 
```
{
  "continuous_batcher": {
    "max_pack_size": 8,
    "max_batch_duration_ms": 40,
    "enable_seqlen_bucketing": true
  }
}
```

alex: doing that now on us-west-2 canary (3 nodes) before full rollout.

deploy-bot: Started runtime-config update on cluster us-west-2-canary by alex.

maya: also consider fairness tweak: set `weight_by_seq_len=true` so long requests don't hog scheduler. That reduces packing incentive for very long sequences.

jun: note: long sequences also evict KV caches causing more paging. If we keep huge packs, paging increases and amplifies tail latency.

alex: update: applied `max_pack_size=8` + `max_batch_duration_ms=40` on canary. Waiting 60s for metric stabilization.

(t + 60s)

alex: metrics: p99 down from 4.2s -> 1.6s on canary, p95 unchanged. streaming stalls down ~60% in canary.

sam: good signal. propose gradual rollout to remainder of us-west-2 with monitor window 5m and auto-rollback if p99 > 1.5s.

maya: also enable `preemptive_shed=true` for packs older than 120ms to avoid head-of-queue blockade. That will sacrifice a few low-priority requests instead of blocking all streaming.

jun: customer comms: ops-team should notify AcmeHealth that we identified transient batching-induced stalls and applied mitigations; full RCA to follow.

alex: doing canary -> 50% -> 100% with 5m watch windows. Rolling now.

deploy-bot: Runtime-config rollout: canary -> 50% (10 nodes) by alex.

(t + 6m)

alex: rollout at 50% looks stable. p99 us-west-2 cluster-wide at ~1.1s. streaming stall rate down to 0.9% (from 3%).

sam: keep an eye on throughput and cost impact — smaller packs can increase per-token GPU overhead. Open cost spike alert if QPS falls or tokens/sec drops >10%.

maya: I'll set an alert to watch tokens/sec and average gpu-occupancy. Also start a short-lived eval to ensure output quality unchanged.

jun: postmortem notes to capture: root cause = mixed sequence-length workload created oversized packs in continuous-batching; scheduler didn’t enforce seqlen-aware fairness; KV cache churn + paging exacerbated tail.

alex: actionable follow-ups:
- short-term: keep `max_pack_size=8`, `max_batch_duration_ms=40`, enable seqlen bucketing + preemptive_shed on us-west-2 for 24h
- medium: implement `weight_by_seq_len` in scheduler and a faster path for short sequences
- long-term: telemetry: add pack size histogram + per-pack seqlen variance metric; add canary test that simulates mixed-seqlen fan-in.

sam: assigned follow-ups: medium -> taylor, long-term -> engineering roadmap, add eval -> maya.

(t + 1h)

alex: final update: p99 stable at 950ms, p95 650ms, streaming stalls back to baseline. Rolling config persisted. Closing incident but will create incident report and link.

incident-bot: Incident channel set to resolved by alex. Duration ~1h.

maya: I'm drafting the RCA with graphs and command snippets. Will ping here when ready.

jun: thanks team. extra: add a note in runbook about prioritizing seqlen-bucketing for chatty customers.

sam: adding customer notify draft and scheduling a sync with AcmeHealth tomorrow.

(taylor): :thumbsup:
